spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg((data->>'cpu_utilization')::float8) "CPU utilization"
FROM
  psutil_cpu
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg(cpu_utilization) "CPU utilization-$lag_interval"
FROM (
SELECT
  time + '$lag_interval'::interval as time,
  (data->>'cpu_utilization')::float8 as cpu_utilization
FROM
  psutil_cpu
WHERE
  dbname = '$dbname'
  and time between ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - '$lag_interval'::interval) and ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - '$lag_interval'::interval)
) x
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg((data->>'iowait')::float8) as "IOWait"
FROM
  psutil_cpu
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg(iowait) "IOWait-$lag_interval"
FROM (
SELECT
  time + '$lag_interval'::interval as time,
  (data->>'iowait')::float8 as iowait
FROM
  psutil_cpu
WHERE
  dbname = '$dbname'
  and time between ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - '$lag_interval'::interval) and ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - '$lag_interval'::interval)
) x
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg((data->>'percent')::float8) as "Mem. used"
FROM
  psutil_mem
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg(used) "Mem. used-$lag_interval"
FROM (
SELECT
  time + '$lag_interval'::interval as time,
  (data->>'percent')::float8 as used
FROM
  psutil_mem
WHERE

  and time between ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - '$lag_interval'::interval) and ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - '$lag_interval'::interval)
) x
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT

GROUP BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),

FROM (
SELECT

WHERE
  dbname = '$dbname'
  and time between ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - '$lag_interval'::interval) and ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - '$lag_interval'::interval)
) x
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg((data->>'available')::float8) as "Mem. available"
FROM
  psutil_mem
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg(available) "Mem. available-$lag_interval"
FROM (
SELECT
  time + '$lag_interval'::interval as time,
  (data->>'available')::float8 as available
FROM
  psutil_mem
WHERE
  dbname = '$dbname'
  and time between ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - '$lag_interval'::interval) and ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - '$lag_interval'::interval)
) x
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg((CASE WHEN read_bytes >= read_bytes_lag THEN (read_bytes_lag - read_bytes) ELSE -read_bytes END) / extract(epoch from time_lag - time))::int8 as "read_bytes_s"
FROM (
  SELECT
    time,
    lag(time) over w as time_lag,
    (data->>'read_bytes')::int8 as read_bytes,
    lag((data->>'read_bytes')::int8) over w as read_bytes_lag
  FROM
    psutil_disk_io_total
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(time)
    AND dbname = '$dbname'
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time)
) x
WHERE time > time_lag
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg((CASE WHEN read_bytes >= read_bytes_lag THEN (read_bytes_lag - read_bytes) ELSE -read_bytes END) / extract(epoch from time_lag - time))::int8 as "read_bytes_s-$lag_interval"
FROM (
  SELECT
    time + '$lag_interval'::interval as time,
    lag(time) over w + '$lag_interval'::interval as time_lag,
    (data->>'read_bytes')::int8 as read_bytes,
    lag((data->>'read_bytes')::int8) over w as read_bytes_lag
  FROM

  WHERE

ORDER BY 1

SELECT

    AND dbname = '$dbname'
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time)
) x
WHERE time > time_lag
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
